instruction: Change the default font to Calibri in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default font in LibreOffice Writer to Calibri. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu configuration file to verify the default font setting has been changed to 'Calibri'. This uses the existing find_default_font metric function.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if default font is set to Calibri, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly fetches the LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu) where default font settings are stored
The find_default_font function uses the correct XPath to extract the default font setting: /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont with Standard property
Performs exact string comparison between extracted font name and expected 'Calibri', which is semantically correct for font name matching
Complete coverage: the evaluator checks the exact requirement stated in the instruction (default font = Calibri)
Expected value 'Calibri' is semantically correct and matches the instruction requirement
No postconfig needed as the configuration file is persistent and doesn't require the application to be open
Proper error handling: returns 0 if file is None or XML parsing fails
